title: Influence identity inside the threshold interval
statement: Let $0<\varepsilon<\tfrac12$, and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. There is a bias parameter $p$ strictly between the lower and upper threshold parameters for $f$ at error level $\varepsilon$ such that the total influence of $f$, under the product distribution of signs with bias determined by $p$, equals $\frac{\sigma(p)^2(1-2\varepsilon)}{w}$, where $\sigma(p)$ is the bias standard deviation and $w$ is the difference between the upper and lower threshold parameters.
